attributes.body:
ASSA ABLOY to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control.

Aug 03, 2026, 02:16 ET

STOCKHOLM, Aug. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ - ASSA ABLOY has signed an agreement to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control, an international provider of entrance control solutions, including speed gates, mass transit gates and security revolving doors.

"I look forward to welcoming the Gunnebo Entrance Control team to ASSA ABLOY. This acquisition delivers on our strategy to strengthen our position in mature markets through adding complementary products and solutions to our core business," says Nico Delvaux, President and CEO of ASSA ABLOY.

"Gunnebo Entrance Control's well-established entrance control portfolio, strong team, and deep industry expertise will enhance and complement our current offering in pedestrian access solutions," says Massimo Grassi, Executive Vice President of ASSA ABLOY and Head of Entrance Systems Division. "By adding talented people, strong expertise, and innovative solutions, we will further strengthen our ability to support customers with secure, reliable and efficient entrance solutions."

Formed in 1995, with a history dating back to 1764, the company has around 670 employees. The company is headquartered in Maresfield, UK, with manufacturing sites across Europe, the US and Asia. Gunnebo Entrance Control will be part of the Business Segment Pedestrian within the Entrance Systems Division.

Sales for 2025 amounted to about MEUR 151 (approx. MSEK 1,670) with a good EBIT margin. The acquisition will initially have a small dilutive effect on EPS.

The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions and is expected to close during the fourth quarter of 2026.

About ASSA ABLOY

ASSA ABLOY is the global leader in access solutions. Every day we help people feel safe, secure and experience a more open world. We operate worldwide with 64,000 employees and sales of SEK 152 billion, with leading positions in areas such as efficient door openings, trusted identities and entrance automation. Our innovations enable safe, secure and convenient access to physical and digital places.

attributes.body:
Gunnebo acquires Shuretech: enhancing UK security services.

11 Mar 2026

Quick Read

Summary is AI-generated, newsdesk-reviewed

* Gunnebo Entrance Control acquires Shuretech to enhance UK service-led engineering and support strategy.
* Shuretech's expertise in gates, barriers, and turnstiles strengthens Gunnebo's entrance control services.
* Acquisition supports Gunnebo's European growth, improving consistency, maintenance, and customer support.

Gunnebo Entrance Control has completed its acquisition of Shuretech Ltd, a move intended to enhance its service-centric approach within the UK market by integrating Shuretech's proficiency in field engineering.

This strategic acquisition brings together a history of field engineering expertise with a service-oriented operational model.

About Shuretech.

Established in 2011, Shuretech has carved out a niche in the South East of England with its expertise in installing, maintaining, and providing lifecycle support for gates, barriers, turnstiles, doors, and shutters.

The company has earned recognition for its technically skilled engineers and its structured programmes for preventative maintenance, along with its effective fault resolution approach.

Expanding services.

Carl Graham and Lewis Hakesley, joint owners of Shuretech Ltd, remarked on the role of service quality and technical competence in their operations: "Service quality and technical competence have always been central to our business. Our engineers work closely with customers to ensure systems operate safely and effectively throughout their lifecycle. Joining Gunnebo Entrance Control allows us to extend this capability further, combining our practical field expertise with broader engineering resources while maintaining the standards and responsiveness our clients expect."

Acquisition benefits.

Shuretech integration boosts Gunnebo's UK maintenance, diagnostics and complianceThis acquisition underscores the growing emphasis on reliable service from the initial design and specification stages through to long-term aftercare in entrance and perimeter control.

The integration of Shuretech's service infrastructure is set to bolster Gunnebo Entrance Control's ability to provide consistent maintenance, quick diagnostics and compliance assurance through its directly managed UK engineering team.

Expert insights.

Blanca Sebastia, EVP Commercial Excellence & GM Europe at Gunnebo Entrance Control, highlighted the significance of this expansion: "Expanding our service footprint in the UK is a key step in delivering our European growth strategy. Shuretech brings strong local capability that helps us scale a more consistent service model across priority markets."

Howard Lang, President of Gunnebo Entrance Control, noted: "Bringing Shuretech into the business significantly strengthens our UK engineering capability and reinforces our service-led model. It positions us to deliver greater consistency, accountability and long-term support for customers who depend on secure, high-performing entrance control systems."

The acquisition demonstrates a mutual commitment to high service standards and long-term support for customers within the UK market, aligning with Gunnebo Entrance Control's emphasis on dependable service.
